target: UTM-bundled QEMU framework, HVF, virtio-ramfb, 1 vCPU, 1 GiB RAM, VirtIO keyboard/tablet
command: QEMU=build/utm-qemu-probe/qemu-probe QEMU_VIRT='-L /Applications/UTM.app/Contents/Resources/qemu -machine virt,accel=hvf,gic-version=3 -cpu host -smp 1 -m 1024 -device virtio-ramfb -device virtio-keyboard-device -device virtio-tablet-device' ZEAL_COMPAT_LOG_PATH=build/check-span-cold-current.log python3 -u scripts/check-compat.py --pci --quick --probe-span-cold
verified: Span created a bridge mass through the normal graphical editor and visibly changed the frame.
The stock Save dialog wrote /Home/Span/Game.DATA to the disposable VirtIO disk.
The stock Open chooser restored the edited bridge after New cleared it.
Escape cleanup returned to a working terminal; 40+2 returned 42 and zstatus reported failed=0.
After flushing and cold-booting from the VirtIO disk, Span reopened Game.DATA and restored the saved mass.
scope_note: Headless automated acceptance with UTM's bundled QEMU framework. This proves the save/reopen path on this disposable VirtIO disk, not physical Pi storage or interaction in the visible UTM window.
